notes: GoldSrc (Half-Life 1 engine): the game directory valve/ holds liblist.gam, the mod description the engine reads (https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Liblist.gam); Xash3D FWGS runs the same tree (https://github.com/FWGS/xash3d-fwgs, 'copy valve folder'). A standalone mod folder without valve/ is not matched on purpose: liblist.gam alone names a mod, not an installed engine. No enginehost plugin yet.
